title: Visualize Legal Data on Demand in Harvey
format_note: Silent, music-only film showing one feature: typing a prompt into Harvey and getting an interactive HTML artifact back, three times with different prompts.
one_thing: Type a plain-English request and Harvey returns a working timeline, chart or dashboard file, shown as prompt, file chip, finished artifact.

transcript.voice_style: No speech. Local whisper returned only 'Music' tags; the transcript tool was unavailable.
transcript.script_shape: All meaning is carried by typed prompts and on-screen UI text; the typed prompt is the narration.

structure.frame0: Cropped, zoomed prompt box on a light grey ground: placeholder 'Ask Harvey anything' with caret, Files and Sources buttons. Product and brand name are in frame at t=0 (f0001.jpg).
structure.first_3s: Zooms in on the prompt box, hard-cuts at 1.93s to a white screen where a giant 'C' and caret appear at 2.77s and grow letter by letter. Hook is a typed command.

beats.what: Empty Harvey prompt box 'Ask Harvey anything', camera pushes in on it.
Prompt re-typed as giant type, one letter per cut: C, Cr, Cre, Create.
Prompt continues, 'Create a' then '...tive litigation timeline', text scrolling left under a caret.
Pull back to the send button; cursor presses the black arrow.
Answer text scrolls up: 'I've created an interactive timeline of all 32 key events in Project Southfield.' plus file chip.
Camera pulls out to the full Harvey app: sidebar, chat, and a timeline of dated events in a side panel.
Push back into the prompt box; types 'Create a structure'; chip harborview-tidewater-structure-chart.html; opens Corporate Structure Chart.
New prompt typed: 'Create a compliance dashboard'.
Cursor clicks meridian-compliance-dashboard.html; Consumer Lending Compliance Dashboard with KPIs and heat map opens.
Large 'Create' with file chips cycling: relationship_map, litigation_dashboard, witness_network.
Serif 'Harvey' wordmark centred on white, held to the end.

hero_moment.what: Compliance dashboard fully rendered: three KPI cards (14, 23, 25) and a 9-row, 7-column colour-coded heat map (f0013.jpg).

ending.what: Wordmark only, no tagline or URL, held 28.7s to 31.56s on white (f0015.jpg, f0016.jpg).

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: One burst of 8 cuts between 1.93s and 4.83s (about 0.35s apart, one per typed letter), then a 22.5s shot (71% of runtime) from 9.03s that covers everything else with camera moves and UI state changes.

look.ground: White with a one-off light grey first scene (f0001.jpg). Almost no contrast beyond black text on white; luma 245, saturation 0.004.
look.accent_use: Colour appears only inside product artifacts: green, amber and red heat-map cells and a blue Pre-Merger tab. The frame around the product stays monochrome.
look.type: Neo-grotesque sans for prompts and UI at huge size; a high-contrast serif for the Harvey wordmark. Prompt text goes from grey placeholder to black typed text.
look.depth: Flat. No shadows or parallax; artifact windows sit on white with a hairline border. Depth comes from zoom scale only.

product_ui.camera_on_ui: Constant punch-ins and pull-outs on a flat screen recording: close on the prompt box, wide on the whole app at 14.4s, close again on file chips.
product_ui.notes: Prompt text and file chips are huge and readable. The full-app wide shot (f0007.jpg) and the heat-map cells are small; the heat map is readable at 720p only after the zoom, and the timeline body text is smaller still.

motion.text_entry: Typed letter by letter with a caret, both in the real prompt box and at poster scale. Letters are revealed by hard cuts at 1.93s-4.83s, one per cut.
motion.ui_motion: Artifacts build in on arrival: timeline rows fade and re-flow at 12s, org-chart nodes appear one by one at 20.1s. File chips shimmer with a light sweep at 10.5s and 22.8s.
motion.camera: Smooth continuous zoom between a close crop and the wide app, no cuts after 9.03s.
motion.eases: Not measured from motion curves. Zoom steps in window-11-14.433s.jpg look fast-out then slow settle.

Zoom out to the app, then zoom into the prompt box.
Send click leads to answer text, chip, then artifact.
Prompt text scrolls left as it grows.

copy.holds_vs_reading_rule: Mostly follows it: the 13-word answer line stays about 1.5s against a 4.4s rule, so it is a glance, not a read. Short prompts and the logo (2.8s, rule 2s) pass.

sound.music: Music only, 136.3 BPM at beat confidence 0.506. Describe tags: music 0.689, percussion 0.355, tabla 0.311, drum 0.282, mallet_percussion 0.235. Two sections, A 0-14.6s and B 14.6-31.55s.
sound.sfx: Not separable from the music; no spoken or effect evidence in audio.json or transcript.
sound.vo_music_balance: No voiceover; music is the whole track.
sound.energy_arc: Strong onsets from 0.5s, dense through the 8-cut burst (about 3-4.8s), steady through B, 0.44s silence at 31.11s before the end.
sound.sync_to_picture: Partly locked: 22.2% of cuts land on strong onsets against 6.1% by chance (+0.161). The section change at 14.635s lines up with the zoom-out/zoom-in at 14.4-15.0s.

good.observation: The prompt is the hook: it is typed at poster scale so the user's request reads in one glance with no voiceover.
Letter-per-cut typing makes a cut burst that has a reason for every cut and sits on audible percussion.
Each demo has the same three-step grammar (prompt, file chip, opened artifact), so the viewer learns it once and reads the next two faster.
Real, specific artifacts: dated timeline events, merger chart, heat map with real labels (Full, Partial, Non-Compl.) make the output credible.
A single 22.5s continuous shot replaces cuts for the rest of the film, so camera movement itself is the transition.
Plain white restraint ending: wordmark alone for 2.8s on the quietest frame.

weak.observation: The full-app wide shot and the compliance heat map appear small; the wide timeline text is unreadable at phone width.
No tagline, URL or call to action; the film ends on the logo and never says what to do next.
The artifacts open and are replaced within a few seconds (dashboard visible about 2s), too short to read the data that proves the feature.
weak.evidence: f0012.jpg at 22s, f0013.jpg at 24s, f0014.jpg at 26s

weak.observation: The timeline reveal has smeared overlapping text as rows animate in, which reads as a blur artifact rather than a build.

rule_candidates.rule: Type the prompt at poster scale (60%+ of frame height for the first letters) and reveal one letter per hard cut for 8 cuts in about 3 s.
A cut burst may sit early (1.9-4.8s, 11% of runtime) if every cut reveals a new typed letter; the burst-at-mid rule is for energy films without a typing device.
After the burst, hold one continuous shot of 20s or more with camera moves and UI state changes as the only seams.
Repeat one demo grammar (prompt, file chip, artifact) three times with new content so the second and third round read in under 3 s each.
rule_candidates.evidence: t=15-22 and 22-26 rounds vs t=2-14 round

rule_candidates.rule: Start frame 0 on the product's own input field zoomed to 100% width, with the brand's name in the placeholder.
Show the output artifact with real labels and numbers (14 / 23 / 25 and a 9x7 heat map) rather than a mock grid, and hold it 2s or more.
End on a wordmark alone for at least 2.5s with the music dropping to silence for the last 0.4s.
Place the zoom reveal from a close crop to the whole app at the music section change.
